title: Path2Spec: Path-Aware Specification Generation via Large Language Models
title_zh: 路径感知规范生成框架 Path2Spec

paragraphs.en: Formal specifications are critical for program verification, comprehension, and maintenance. However, manually writing them is costly and difficult to scale. Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) are promising for automated specification generation, but existing methods suffer from quality issues. We analyze a state-of-the-art approach and find that at least 34.6% of successfully verified specifications actually fail to meaningfully capture the program’s distinct behavior, which is a quality issue not captured by metrics that only measure verification success. We further found that a major factor contributing to such hidden quality issues stems from the design of existing methods: these methods treat a program as a single unit, resulting in overly general, coarse-grained constraints. To this end, we introduce Path2Spec , a divide-and-conquer framework that addresses these limitations through systematic path-based reasoning. Path2Spec leverages LLMs to extract all execution paths from an input program, generates path-specific specifications for each, and merges them into a comprehensive overall specification. For complex programs where path-based generation struggles, Path2Spec employs a decompose-then-retry strategy that recursively breaks a program into smaller subprograms based on logical branches, generates specifications for each, and merges them back. We evaluate Path2Spec on two public benchmarks: SG-Bench (120 programs) and SV-COMP (265 programs). Results show that Path2Spec can outperform the state-of-the-art baseline SpecGen: 87.5% versus 66.7% on SG-Bench, and 83.0% versus 44.2% on SV-COMP. Human evaluation further validates that Path2Spec generates higher-quality specifications with precise semantic alignment to the code. Our work demonstrates that our path-based specification generation strategy substantially enhances the quality and accuracy of LLM-generated specifications.

paragraphs.en: Formal specifications are machine-readable descriptions of a program’s expected behavior and intent. Common specifications, such as preconditions (function input requirements), postconditions (output properties), and loop invariants (conditions preserved across iterations), serve as concise annotations to source code. Such specifications are fundamental to program comprehension, formal verification, and long-term maintenance. For instance, preconditions and postconditions can help automatically generate unit tests for code ( Dakhel et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 形式化规范是对程序预期行为和意图的机器可读描述。 常见的规范，例如前提条件（函数输入要求）、后件条件（输出属性）和循环不变量（在迭代过程中保持成立的条件），可用作源代码的简洁注释。 这类规范对于程序理解、形式化验证和长期维护至关重要。 例如，前提条件和后件条件可以帮助自动为代码生成单元测试（Dakhel 等人，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Writing formal specifications for a specific program is challenging because it relies heavily on human experts on human experts, which is both expensive and hard-to-scale. To this end, automated specification generation tools have been proposed. For example, Daikon ( Ernst et al., 2007 ) uses dynamic analysis to infer likely invariants by statistically generalizing over large execution traces, whereas Houdini ( Flanagan and Leino, 2001 ) applies static, theorem-prover-driven inference that iteratively eliminates counterexamples. More recently, researchers have explored using Large Language Models (LLMs) for specification synthesis ( Ge et al., 2023 ) . For example, AutoSpec ( Wen et al., 2024 ) utilizes LLMs to generate candidate specifications, which are subsequently verified through program verification to filter out incorrect ones. As an improvement over AutoSpec, SpecGen ( Ma et al., 2025 ) employs a conversational approach for iterative enhancement and applies mutation operators with a heuristic selection strategy to refine and verify the specifications when the LLM fails. Compared to traditional tools, these LLM-based methods have demonstrated superior performance and wider applicability, indicating a promising technical pathway.
paragraphs.zh: 为特定程序编写正式规范具有挑战性，因为这严重依赖人类专家，既成本高昂又难以扩展。 为此，人们提出了自动规范生成工具。 例如，Daikon（Ernst 等人，2007）利用动态分析，通过对大规模执行轨迹进行统计归纳来推断可能的不变量；而 Houdini（Flanagan 和 Leino，2001）则采用由定理证明器驱动的静态推理方法，通过迭代消除反例来推导规范。 近期，研究人员开始探索使用大语言模型（LLM）进行规范合成（Ge 等人，2023）。 例如，AutoSpec（Wen 等人，2024）利用 LLM 生成候选规范，随后通过程序验证筛选出错误的规范。 作为对 AutoSpec 的改进，SpecGen（Ma 等人，2025）采用对话式方法实现迭代增强，并在 LLM 失败时运用启发式选择策略配合变异算子来优化和验证规范。 与传统工具相比，这些基于 LLM 的方法展现出更优异的性能和更广泛的应用性，表明这是一条充满希望的技术路径。

paragraphs.en: However, such LLM-based methods focus on generating valid specifications while ignoring their quality, especially in the coverage of the program’s behaviors. Coverage refers to whether the formal specification provides corresponding descriptions for all possible execution scenarios of the program. If a program has many execution paths, but only a few of them are correctly described in a specification, we consider such a specification to have low coverage. This lack of coverage cannot be detected by standard verifiers. Verifiers merely determine if the postconditions are satisfied given the preconditions; this check does not guarantee that all possible execution behaviors have been captured. To fill this gap, we propose a metric called Logical Strength. It compares the relative logical quality of two (precondition, postcondition) pairs by evaluating the strictness of their constraints. The comparison focuses on whether the generated specification narrows the input range through its precondition and broadens the output range through its postcondition. Relative to the ground-truth specification, if the generated precondition admits a narrower range of inputs while the generated postcondition permits a broader range of outputs, then the generated (precondition, postcondition) pair is considered a logically incomplete specification.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这类基于大型语言模型的方法专注于生成有效的规范，却忽视了这些规范的质量，尤其是在程序行为覆盖方面。 覆盖性指的是形式规范是否对程序所有可能的执行场景都提供了相应的描述。 如果一个程序有很多执行路径，但规范中只有少数路径被正确描述，那么我们认为该规范的覆盖性较低。 这种覆盖性的缺失无法通过标准验证器检测出来。 验证器仅能判断在给定前提条件的情况下，后置条件是否得到满足；这种检查并不能保证所有可能的执行行为都已被涵盖。 为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种名为“逻辑强度”的度量指标。 它通过评估两个（前提条件，后置条件）对的约束严格性，来比较它们的相对逻辑质量。 该比较重点关注生成的规范是否通过其前提条件缩小了输入范围，并通过其后置条件扩大了输出范围。 相对于基准规范，如果生成的前提条件允许更窄的输入范围，而生成的后置条件则允许更宽的输出范围，那么生成的（前提条件，后置条件）对就被视为逻辑上不完整的规范。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, we manually examine the generated specifications, which further reveals the main failure mode of this issue. We illustrate this using an example. In Figure 1 , the specification of the output is Integer.MIN_VALUE <= r esult && result <= Integer.MAX_VALUE , a valid but overly broad postcondition since it is always true for all possible values. However, the program has three distinct execution paths with each satisfying its unique constraints, i.e., three different (precondition, postcondition) pairs in total. Therefore, although the LLM generated a valid specification, it fails to capture the distinct execution paths of the program, thereby providing no meaningful constraint or insight into the program’s true functionality.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们手动检查了生成的规格说明，这进一步揭示了该问题的主要失效模式。 我们通过一个例子来说明这一点。 在图 1 中，输出的规格说明为 Integer.MIN_VALUE <= result && result <= Integer.MAX_VALUE，这是一个有效但过于宽泛的后置条件，因为它对所有可能的值都始终成立。 然而，该程序有三条不同的执行路径，每条路径都满足其独特的约束条件，即总共存在三对不同的（前置条件，后置条件）。 因此，尽管 LLM 生成了一个有效的规格说明，但它未能捕捉到程序的独特执行路径，从而无法为程序的真实功能提供任何有意义的约束或洞见。

sents.en: However, the program has three distinct execution paths with each satisfying its unique constraints, i.e., three different (precondition, postcondition) pairs in total.

sents.en: Therefore, although the LLM generated a valid specification, it fails to capture the distinct execution paths of the program, thereby providing no meaningful constraint or insight into the program’s true functionality.
sents.zh: 因此，尽管 LLM 生成了一个有效的规格说明，但它未能捕捉到程序的独特执行路径，从而无法为程序的真实功能提供任何有意义的约束或洞见。

paragraphs.en: This limitation originates from the design of existing approaches such as SpecGen ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and AutoSpec ( Wen et al., 2024 ) , which typically treat the entire program as a single unit, prompting the model to generate specifications for the whole code at once. Without explicit path-level guidance, LLMs tend to produce coarse-grained specifications, i.e., overly broad method-level constraints that summarize the program as a whole. Although such specifications can easily pass the verifier’s check, they often fail to distinguish different input regions and execution paths, and therefore cannot precisely characterize the program’s path-specific outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 这一局限性源于现有方法（如 SpecGen (Ma et al., 2025) 和 AutoSpec (Wen et al., 2024)）的设计，这些方法通常将整个程序视为一个单一单元，从而促使模型一次性为整个代码生成规格。 在没有明确的路径级指导时，大型语言模型倾向于生成粗粒度的规格，即过于宽泛的方法级约束，仅对程序整体进行概括。 尽管这类规格能够轻松通过验证器的检查，但它们往往无法区分不同的输入区域和执行路径，因此也无法精确描述程序在特定路径下的输出结果。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, although LLMs already demonstrate strong capabilities in understanding code semantics, generating specifications that precisely capture the intended program behavior remains a challenging and unsolved problem.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，尽管大型语言模型（LLM）已经展现出强大的代码语义理解能力，但生成能够精确捕捉程序预期行为的规范仍然是一个具有挑战性的未解难题。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we aim to address the challenges of generating both correct and high-quality program specifications. Specifically, we propose Path2Spec , a divide-and-conquer framework designed to generate specifications that accurately capture fine-grained program behaviors. By systematically forcing an LLM to reason over individual execution paths, our approach ultimately produces path-specific and highly detailed specifications. Specifically, Path2Spec first uses an LLM to extract all distinct execution paths from the input program. It then generates a path-specific specification for each, which is subsequently merged to construct the overall program specification. This path-level reasoning significantly improves the precision and detail of the output. However, when the program is too complex, LLMs may struggle to generate correct specifications, even when guided by a specific path. Therefore, we further propose a decompose-then-retry strategy. For a program that an LLM fails to produce correct path-based specifications, we decompose it into smaller subprograms based on its logical branches and retry the path-based generation to produce specifications for each subprogram. This decompose-then-retry process repeats if the generation for any subprogram still fails. Finally, the specifications for all subprograms are merged to form the overall specifications for the original input program.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们的目标是解决生成既正确又高质量的程序规格说明所面临的挑战。 具体来说，我们提出了 Path2Spec——一个分治框架，旨在生成能够准确捕捉细粒度程序行为的规格说明。 通过系统性地迫使大型语言模型对单个执行路径进行推理，我们的方法最终能够生成针对特定路径的高度详细规格说明。 具体而言，Path2Spec 首先利用大型语言模型从输入程序中提取所有不同的执行路径。 接着，它为每条路径生成特定的规格说明，然后将这些说明合并以构建完整的程序规格说明。 这种基于路径的推理显著提升了输出结果的精确度和细节程度。 然而，当程序过于复杂时，即使有特定路径的引导，大型语言模型也可能难以生成正确的规格说明。 因此，我们进一步提出了一种“分解-重试”策略。 对于大型语言模型无法生成正确路径化规格说明的程序，我们会根据其逻辑分支将其分解为更小的子程序，然后对每个子程序重新尝试基于路径的生成过程以产生其规格说明。 如果任何子程序的生成仍然失败，这一“分解-重试”过程将会重复执行。 最后，将所有子程序的规格说明合并，即可形成原始输入程序的完整规格说明。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the usefulness of Path2Spec , we have conducted extensive experiments on two public datasets used by prior works, SpecGenBench (SG-Bench) ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and SV-COMP ( Beyer, 2024 ) , respectively comprising 120 and 265 Java programs. The experimental results demonstrate that Path2Spec achieves substantial improvements. On SG-Bench, Path2Spec achieves 87.5% pass@1 compared to the baseline’s 66.7%. On SV-COMP, Path2Spec reaches 83.0% versus SpecGen’s 44.2%. Additionally, we perform an ablation study to separately validate the effectiveness of providing path information as guidance (Path-only) and decomposing programs to reduce program complexity (Decomposition-only) across the same four base LLMs on both benchmark datasets. The results confirm that both Path-only and Decomposition-only strategies outperform the baseline across both datasets, demonstrating the positive impact of each component. On SG-Bench, Path-only achieves 82.5% and Decomposition-only achieves 77.5%, while on SV-COMP, Path-only reaches 81.1% and Decomposition-only achieves 60.8%. Notably, neither strategy alone surpasses Path2Spec ’s performance. Therefore, combining both methods further strengthens Path2Spec ’s capability in generating formal specifications. Furthermore, human evaluation shows that Path2Spec generates higher-quality specifications than the baseline, achieving an average score of 3.4 versus 2.4 (out of 4). The generated specifications are semantically aligned with programs and exhibit more comprehensive coverage of actual program execution behaviors.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we briefly review automated specification generation methods and reveal the low-coverage issue of existing LLM-based methods.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将简要回顾自动规范生成方法，并揭示现有基于大语言模型的方法所存在的覆盖率低的问题。

paragraphs.en: Conventional formal specification generation relies on symbolic or rule-based techniques, which can be categorized into dynamic and static methods. Dynamic approaches (e.g., Daikon ( Ernst et al., 2007 ) ) infer likely specifications by analyzing execution traces. Their major advantage is that they do not require reasoning about the program’s source-level semantics. However, their heavy reliance on test-suite coverage often leads to false positives: an incomplete test suite may fail to exercise all program behaviors, yielding specifications that are too weak or that contain spurious invariants holding only for the observed executions rather than for all possible ones ( Ernst et al., 2007 ) . In contrast, static approaches (e.g., Houdini ( Flanagan and Leino, 2001 ) ) analyze source code, data flow, and control flow, and use theorem provers to verify candidate specifications instantiated from templates. This paradigm aims to be sound for all possible inputs and thus offers stronger correctness guarantees. Nevertheless, it is constrained by the expressiveness of its templates and the reasoning capability of the verifier, frequently resulting in false negatives and requiring manually provided auxiliary invariants. Moreover, both dynamic and static methods depend heavily on predefined syntactic templates (e.g., x < y , arr.length > 0 ). This fundamental limitation confines them to inferring simple invariants of specific forms, making them inadequate for discovering complex or domain-specific logical constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 传统的正式规约生成依赖于符号化或基于规则的技术，这些技术可分为动态方法和静态方法。 动态方法（例如 Daikon (Ernst et al., 2007)）通过分析执行轨迹来推断可能的规约。 它们的主要优势在于无需对程序的源代码语义进行推理。 然而，它们对测试套件覆盖率的过度依赖常常导致误报：不完整的测试套件可能无法覆盖程序的所有行为，从而生成过于弱或仅对已观察到的执行有效而非所有可能执行都有效的虚假不变量（Ernst et al., 2007）。 相比之下，静态方法（例如 Houdini (Flanagan and Leino, 2001)）会分析源代码、数据流和控制流，并利用定理证明器来验证从模板实例化出的候选规约。 这种范式旨在对所有可能的输入都保持正确性，因此能提供更强的正确性保证。 尽管如此，它受到模板表达能力和验证器推理能力的限制，常常导致漏报，并需要手动提供辅助不变量。 此外，动态和静态方法都严重依赖预定义的语法模板（例如 x < y，arr.length > 0）。 这一根本性限制使它们只能推断特定形式的简单不变量，因而无法发现复杂或领域特定的逻辑约束。

sents.en: Conventional formal specification generation relies on symbolic or rule-based techniques, which can be categorized into dynamic and static methods.
sents.zh: 传统的正式规约生成依赖于符号化或基于规则的技术，这些技术可分为动态方法和静态方法。

sents.en: Dynamic approaches (e.g., Daikon ( Ernst et al., 2007 ) ) infer likely specifications by analyzing execution traces.
sents.zh: 动态方法（例如 Daikon (Ernst et al., 2007)）通过分析执行轨迹来推断可能的规约。

sents.en: Their major advantage is that they do not require reasoning about the program’s source-level semantics.
sents.zh: 它们的主要优势在于无需对程序的源代码语义进行推理。

sents.en: However, their heavy reliance on test-suite coverage often leads to false positives: an incomplete test suite may fail to exercise all program behaviors, yielding specifications that are too weak or that contain spurious invariants holding only for the observed executions rather than for all possible ones ( Ernst et al., 2007 ) .
sents.zh: 然而，它们对测试套件覆盖率的过度依赖常常导致误报：不完整的测试套件可能无法覆盖程序的所有行为，从而生成过于弱或仅对已观察到的执行有效而非所有可能执行都有效的虚假不变量（Ernst et al., 2007）。

sents.en: In contrast, static approaches (e.g., Houdini ( Flanagan and Leino, 2001 ) ) analyze source code, data flow, and control flow, and use theorem provers to verify candidate specifications instantiated from templates.
sents.zh: 相比之下，静态方法（例如 Houdini (Flanagan and Leino, 2001)）会分析源代码、数据流和控制流，并利用定理证明器来验证从模板实例化出的候选规约。

sents.en: This paradigm aims to be sound for all possible inputs and thus offers stronger correctness guarantees.
sents.zh: 这种范式旨在对所有可能的输入都保持正确性，因此能提供更强的正确性保证。

sents.en: Nevertheless, it is constrained by the expressiveness of its templates and the reasoning capability of the verifier, frequently resulting in false negatives and requiring manually provided auxiliary invariants.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，它受到模板表达能力和验证器推理能力的限制，常常导致漏报，并需要手动提供辅助不变量。

sents.en: Moreover, both dynamic and static methods depend heavily on predefined syntactic templates (e.g., x < y , arr.length > 0 ).
sents.zh: 此外，动态和静态方法都严重依赖预定义的语法模板（例如 x < y，arr.length > 0）。

sents.en: This fundamental limitation confines them to inferring simple invariants of specific forms, making them inadequate for discovering complex or domain-specific logical constraints.
sents.zh: 这一根本性限制使它们只能推断特定形式的简单不变量，因而无法发现复杂或领域特定的逻辑约束。

paragraphs.en: Recent years have witnessed a rapid shift toward LLM-based techniques. Having learned semantic patterns from vast code corpora, LLMs can directly generate flexible, human-readable specifications, e.g., in the Java Modeling Language (JML), without relying on predefined templates or fixed grammars ( Bairi et al., 2024 ) . Existing work has progressively refined this paradigm. AutoSpec ( Wen et al., 2024 ) adopts a generate-and-verify loop: the LLM proposes candidate specifications, and a verifier then filters out those that fail verification; this cycle repeats until all remaining specifications pass the verifier. SpecGen ( Ma et al., 2025 ) goes one step further by feeding the error messages produced by the verifier (e.g., OpenJML ( Cok, 2011 ) ) back to the LLM, allowing it to refine its output incrementally and converge on verifiable annotations. Both approaches confirm that LLMs can move beyond fixed templates and rapidly synthesize sophisticated, machine-checkable specifications. However, these methods focus solely on correctness, which does not guarantee the quality of the generated specifications. We elaborate on this limitation in the next subsection.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，我们见证了向基于大型语言模型（LLM）的技术的迅速转变。 通过在庞大的代码语料库中学习语义模式，LLM可以直接生成灵活且人类可读的规范，例如使用Java建模语言（JML），而无需依赖预定义的模板或固定的语法（Bairi等，2024）。 现有研究逐步完善了这一范式。 AutoSpec（Wen等，2024）采用“生成-验证”循环：LLM提出候选规范，随后由验证器过滤掉未能通过验证的规范；这一循环持续重复，直到所有剩余的规范都通过验证器。 SpecGen（Ma等，2025）更进一步，将验证器产生的错误信息（例如OpenJML（Cok，2011））反馈给LLM，使其能够逐步优化输出，并最终收敛到可验证的标注上。 这两种方法都证实了LLM能够超越固定模板，快速合成复杂且机器可检查的规范。 然而，这些方法仅关注正确性，而正确性并不能保证所生成规范的质量。 我们将在下一小节中详细阐述这一局限性。

paragraphs.en: To reveal the quality issues of existing methods, we quantitatively and qualitatively analyze the performance of SpecGen on SpecEval ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , a benchmark of 125 Java programs paired with verified human-written specifications, which together contain 173 (precondition, postcondition) pairs. Specifically, we run SpecGen with GPT-3.5-turbo as the base LLM and compare the generated specifications with their human-written counterparts. This comparison follows a simple principle: relative to the ground truth, a generated specification should neither narrow the admissible input range (i.e., have a stronger precondition) nor widen the permitted output range (i.e., have a weaker postcondition). A stronger precondition admits fewer inputs and thus covers fewer program behaviors, whereas a weaker postcondition characterizes the expected outputs less precisely.
paragraphs.zh: 为了揭示现有方法的质量问题，我们对 SpecGen 在 SpecEval（Ma et al., 2024）上的性能进行了定量和定性分析。SpecEval 是一个基准测试，包含 125 个 Java 程序以及与之对应的、经过验证的人工编写规范，这些程序和规范共同构成了 173 对（前置条件、后置条件）。 具体来说，我们使用 GPT-3.5-turbo 作为基础大语言模型运行 SpecGen，并将生成的规范与人工编写的规范进行比较。 这种比较遵循一个简单的原则：相对于基准真相，生成的规范既不应缩小可接受的输入范围（即具有更强的前置条件），也不应扩大允许的输出范围（即具有更弱的前置条件）。 更强的前置条件允许更少的输入，因此覆盖的程序行为也更少；而更弱的前置条件则对预期输出的描述不够精确。

paragraphs.en: Accordingly, for each human-written (precondition, postcondition) pair, we check whether the LLM produces a corresponding pair whose precondition is at least as weak and whose postcondition is at least as strong, using an SMT-based implication check. For example, if the human-written precondition and postcondition are x >= 0 and y < 0 , respectively, a generated pair of x > 0 and y <= 0 is considered incomplete , since it fails to cover the input x == 0 and additionally admits the output y == 0 . If the two components point in opposite directions (e.g., both the precondition and the postcondition are weaker, or both are stronger), we mark the pair as undetermined .
paragraphs.zh: 因此，对于每一对由人类编写的（前提条件，后件条件），我们使用基于 SMT 的蕴含检查来验证 LLM 是否生成了相应的配对，其中前提条件至少同样弱，而后件条件至少同样强。 例如，如果人类编写的前提条件和后件条件分别是 x >= 0 和 y < 0，那么生成的配对 x > 0 和 y <= 0 会被视为不完整，因为它未能覆盖输入 x == 0 的情况，并且额外允许输出 y == 0。 如果两个组件的方向相反（例如，前提条件和后件条件都更弱，或者都更强），我们将该配对标记为未确定。

paragraphs.en: Of the 173 pairs, 107 SpecGen-generated pairs pass verification. Among these verified pairs, 34.6% are logically incomplete compared with the ground truth, and 27.1% are undetermined, i.e., they exhibit trade-offs such as a weaker precondition paired with a weaker postcondition. We therefore argue that current LLM-generated specifications suffer from significant quality issues, which are obscured by the existing evaluation metric (i.e., whether verification passes).

paragraphs.en: We further manually examine these LLM-generated specifications and observe one main failure mode: oversimplified specifications . This occurs when the model fails to differentiate between distinct logical branches of the code and consequently merges branch-specific preconditions or postconditions into a single, overly general constraint. As shown on the left of Figure 1 , the generated postcondition is Integer.MIN_VALUE <= result && result <= Integer.MAX_VALUE , which holds for every int value and is thus trivially true. However, the implementation involves three distinct execution paths, whose postconditions are result == -1 , result == (num1 > num2 ? num1 : num2) , and num1 % result == 0 && num2 % result == 0 , respectively. Therefore, although the generated postcondition is valid, it is insufficient, since each path has its own specific constraint on the output. A single oversimplified constraint over all inputs cannot meaningfully capture the semantics of the program.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步手动检查了这些由大型语言模型生成的规范，并观察到一个主要故障模式：规范过度简化。 当模型无法区分代码中不同的逻辑分支时，就会出现这种情况，导致它将特定分支的前置条件或后置条件合并为一个过于笼统的单一约束。 如图 1 左侧所示，生成的后置条件是 Integer.MIN_VALUE <= result && result <= Integer.MAX_VALUE，该条件对所有 int 值都成立，因此是显然为真的。 然而，该实现涉及三个不同的执行路径，它们的后置条件分别是 result == -1、result == (num1 > num2 ? num1 : num2) 以及 num1 % result == 0 && num2 % result == 0。 因此，尽管生成的后置条件是有效的，但它并不充分，因为每条路径都对输出有各自特定的约束。 一个覆盖所有输入的单一过度简化约束无法真正捕捉程序的语义。

paragraphs.en: These issues stem from the design of existing LLM-based specification generation methods. On the one hand, LLMs are instructed to process the code as a whole without path-specific guidance, and thus overlook path-specific constraints. On the other hand, for complex programs on which LLMs fail to generate correct specifications, they tend to weaken or drop constraints until the verifier accepts them. Consequently, the resulting specifications either fail to capture the program’s actual behavior or impose excessively general constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题源于现有基于大型语言模型（LLM）的规范生成方法的设计。 一方面，LLM 被指示将代码作为一个整体处理，而缺乏针对特定路径的指导，因此会忽略与特定路径相关的约束条件。 另一方面，对于复杂程序，当 LLM 无法生成正确的规范时，它们往往会削弱或省略约束条件，直到验证器接受这些规范为止。 因此，最终生成的规范要么未能准确捕捉程序的實際行为，要么施加了过于宽泛的约束条件。

paragraphs.en: Our observations suggest that this issue is inherent to the design rather than to a particular base model or verifier. Re-running the official SpecGen artifact under the same OpenJML/CVC4 configuration as ours, we find that a large fraction of its verified specifications are vacuous: they contain no postcondition or only ensures true , and pass verification merely because there is nothing to check. This fraction ranges from 25% to 33% with GPT-3.5-turbo and from 13% to 19% with DeepSeek-R1 on the two benchmarks used in our evaluation. For instance, SpecGen passes verification on the branching program if_expr1 with an empty specification, exactly where per-branch postconditions are required. In contrast, the single-shot variant of Path2Spec , which localizes generation to individual paths, produces no vacuous verified specifications (0%).

sents.zh: 该框架采用基于路径的规范生成工作流程，并结合“分解-重试”策略，具体如图 2 所示（详见第 3.1 节和第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, given an input program, Path2Spec first applies the path-based specification generation workflow by instructing an LLM to extract all execution paths from the program and then generate specifications for each path. These path-specific specifications are then verified with the OpenJML verifier. If any specification fails verification, its verification results are sent back to the LLM to iteratively refine the failed specification. Only after all specifications successfully pass the verification process, the workflow is considered complete, and the specifications are merged into a final specification and returned as the output. However, if verification still fails after M rounds of iterative refinement, we consider the program to be too complex for the LLM to perform the path-based specification generation.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，给定一个输入程序，Path2Spec 首先应用基于路径的规范生成工作流程：指导大型语言模型（LLM）从程序中提取所有执行路径，然后为每条路径生成规范。 随后，这些针对特定路径的规范会通过 OpenJML 验证器进行验证。 如果任何规范未能通过验证，其验证结果将被送回给大型语言模型（LLM），以便迭代优化该失败的规范。 只有当所有规范都成功通过验证流程后，整个工作流程才算完成，此时这些规范会被合并为一个最终规范并作为输出返回。 然而，如果在 M 轮迭代优化之后验证仍然失败，我们则认为该程序过于复杂，大型语言模型（LLM）无法执行基于路径的规范生成。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, for such failed cases, we propose a decompose-then-retry strategy to reduce the program’s complexity. Specifically, for a program that fails to yield correct specifications with the path-based specification generation, we decompose it into two smaller subprograms based on its first logical branch. We then retry the aforementioned path-based specification generation workflow to produce corresponding specifications for each subprogram. The generated specifications for these subprograms are independently verified. If all subprogram specifications are successfully verified, they are combined to form the final specification for the original program. Conversely, if any subprogram specification still fails verification after iterative refinement, that subprogram is further decomposed based on its first logical branch, and the generation workflow is repeated. This decompose-then-retry process repeats recursively until either all resulting subprograms are successfully verified and combined, or until a subprogram cannot be further decomposed but still fails verification, at which point the original program is considered unresolvable.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，对于这类失败的情况，我们提出一种“分解-重试”策略来降低程序的复杂性。 具体而言，对于无法通过基于路径的规范生成方法获得正确规范的程序，我们会根据其第一个逻辑分支将其分解为两个较小的子程序。 然后，我们对上述基于路径的规范生成流程进行重试，为每个子程序生成相应的规范。 这些子程序生成的规范将经过独立验证。 如果所有子程序的规范都成功通过验证，它们将被合并，形成原始程序的最终规范。 反之，如果任何子程序的规范在迭代优化后仍无法通过验证，该子程序将基于其第一个逻辑分支进一步分解，并重复生成流程。 这一“分解-重试”过程将递归重复，直到所有生成的子程序都成功通过验证并被合并，或者某个子程序无法进一步分解但仍无法通过验证，此时原始程序将被视为无法解决。

paragraphs.en: Finally, after completing the path-based specification generation, we merge all path-specific specifications together. We primarily employ an interleaved merge-and-verify approach: we first merge the specification from the first path and invoke the verifier. Upon successful verification, we proceed to merge the specification from the second path, continuing this process until all path-specific specifications are successfully merged into the original program. For complex programs, since we initially apply a decompose-then-retry strategy, the merging process is conducted in two steps: first, we progressively integrate all path-specific specifications within each subprogram; then, we progressively integrate the specifications from subprograms into the original program in a bottom-up manner. paragraphs.en: It first extracts all possible execution paths from the input program to guide further generation. The extraction is performed using an LLM. Each path is characterized by its preconditions (input constraints that trigger the path) and postconditions (output expressions or states after execution). Therefore, the path information we aim to extract consists of (Precondition, Postcondition) pairs, where the precondition defines the input conditions under which the path is executed, and the postcondition specifies the resulting output expression.

paragraphs.en: However, current tools are built on dynamic execution engines and rely on analyzing dynamic execution data to infer results ( Samhi et al., 2024 ; Laursen et al., 2024 ) . Second, the path analysis reports use concrete output values as postconditions rather than symbolic expressions. This type of path information provides limited benefit for LLM-based path-specific generation. Consequently, we adopt an LLM to analyze and extract execution paths, which yields more concise and interpretable path information that benefits the downstream workflow. We experimentally compare the performance of using an LLM versus Java PathFinder ( Mehlitz et al., 2013 ) for path extraction in Section 5.3 , providing empirical evidence to support our design choice.

paragraphs.zh: 这些经过优化的规格随后会被验证，如果仍然失败，则再次进行优化。 当规格成功通过验证或达到预定义的迭代次数上限（例如五次迭代）时，这一迭代过程将结束。 如果所有路径的规格最终都被验证为正确，我们将合并所有规格，并将其整合到原始程序中作为输出。 然而，如果完整的综合规格未能通过验证，我们认为当前程序对 LLM 而言过于复杂，难以理解，因此会采用“分解-重试”策略来降低任务复杂度。

paragraphs.en: The decompose-then-retry strategy is a top-down, recursive approach for handling failures in path-based specification generation. Applicable branches include if-else statements, switch statements, and loops (e.g., for, while). To reduce complexity, loops are handled specifically: they are decomposed into two subprograms. One represents the case where the loop condition is satisfied (and the body executes), and the other represents the case where the condition is not met (and the loop is skipped).
paragraphs.zh: “先分解后重试”策略是一种自上而下、递归处理基于路径的规范生成过程中故障的方法。 当输入程序在该生成过程中失败时，该策略会依据其第一层分支条件，将其分解为更简单的子程序。 适用的分支包括 if-else 语句、switch 语句和循环（例如 for、while）。 为了降低复杂性，循环会被特别处理：它们会被分解为两个子程序。 其中一个子程序表示循环条件满足的情况（此时循环体执行），另一个则表示条件不满足的情况（此时循环被跳过）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates this process. The initial input program (at the top of the figure) fails to generate a correct specification and is decomposed based on the if(m % a != 0) branch into subprograms 1.1 and 1.2 . The path-based generation is then retried on both resulting subprograms. In this example, the resulting subprogram 1.2 is simple, thereby easy to get valid specifications for an LLM. Let’s assume subprogram 1.1 still fails. For subprograms that fail in path-based specification generation, the strategy is applied again, further decomposing it based on its first branch, e.g., the m % b != 0 of this subprogram 1.1 . This decompose-then-retry process repeats recursively until one of the following conditions is met: all resulting subprograms are successfully verified, all subprograms contain no control flow statements, or the predefined iteration limit is reached. In this example, the yielded subprograms 1.1.1 and 1.1.2 show significantly reduced complexity, lowering the barrier for the path-based generation to succeed. However, if a subprogram cannot be further decomposed but still fails verification, we consider this case to be a failure and output existing valid specifications of other subprograms as a partial solution. paragraphs.en: In our experiments, we choose the current SOTA specification generation method SpecGen ( Ma et al., 2025 ) as a baseline. All baselines use the official SpecGen artifact without modification (its prompts and pipeline), and both SpecGen and Path2Spec share the same OpenJML/CVC4 verifier configuration, benchmarks, base models, and sampling temperature, so differences reflect the method rather than the setup. SpecGen has already demonstrated its substantial improvement over both traditional approaches (Daikon and Houdini) and the LLM-based method AutoSpec ( Wen et al., 2024 ) . In addition to SpecGen’s origin base LLM, GPT-3.5-turbo ( Ge et al., 2023 ) , we include three additional widely used and state-of-the-art LLMs: GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen-Plus ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ) . These models are selected as they represent the current frontier of LLM capabilities and are popular choices in the research community. GPT-5 is OpenAI’s latest model at the time this work was done, offering enhanced reasoning coherence, improved contextual understanding, and stronger complex problem-solving capabilities, albeit with higher inference costs and longer response times. DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen-Plus are prominent open-source and commercially available models, respectively, known for their competitive reasoning abilities. Our approach is then compared against SpecGen with these LLMs as the base LLMs. All SpecGen experiments are conducted under a consistent conversational prompting strategy with mutation-enabled iterations, allowing up to 10 conversational turns per task.

paragraphs.en: SV-COMP contains 265 Java programs averaging 19.6 lines of code (up to 200). It is branch- and dependency-heavy : programs have 2.0 branches on average (up to 35), 60.8 % 60.8\% (161 programs) have two or more execution paths, and a substantial fraction involve inter-procedural structure, with 33 % 33\% spanning multiple methods and 32 % 32\% recursive, while only 11 % 11\% contain loops. SG-Bench is a smaller but complementary corpus of 120 Java programs averaging 12.6 lines of code (up to 32); 50 % 50\% ( 60 60 programs) have two or more execution paths. In contrast to SV-COMP, it is loop- and nesting-heavy : 59 % 59\% of its programs contain loops and 39 % 39\% reach a control-flow nesting depth of two or more, whereas its programs are almost entirely single-method (only 4 % 4\% are multi-method or recursive).

paragraphs.en: For all experiments, we use the public REST APIs of each base LLM, i.e., GPT-3.5-turbo ( Floridi and Chiriatti, 2020 ) , GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen-Plus ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ) . GPT-3.5-turbo, DeepSeek-R1, and Qwen-Plus are configured with a temperature of 0.7 , while GPT-5 uses its default system setting as it is not configurable. The maximum number of conversational rounds for the LLMs to refine and correct their generated specifications during the path-based specification generation is set to 5 . The decompose-then-retry iteration threshold is set to 3 in our experiments. For GPT-5 we use the official OpenAI API, model snapshot gpt-5-2025-08-07 , queried between August and December 2025. GPT-5 exposes no sampling controls (e.g., temperature), so we use the provider defaults; all other pipeline settings are identical to the other models (at most five refinement rounds, decompose-then-retry threshold three, OpenJML build 21-0-14 with exit code 0 as the pass criterion). The exact model snapshot, prompts, and per-program execution traces are released with the artifact for reproducibility.

paragraphs.en: We use OpenJML ( Cok, 2011 ) , the latest stable release ( build 21-0-14 ) when we conducted our study, as our primary verification tool for formal specifications. OpenJML is configured to examine both the syntax of the generated JML annotations and their semantic alignment with the corresponding Java code. Due to current internal limitations in OpenJML, complex verifications are prone to timeout. Therefore, we set a timeout limit of 30 minutes (1800 seconds); if verification does not return a result within this time, a timeout error is reported. A specification is considered successfully verified only when OpenJML returns a status code of 0 , indicating complete compliance; any other result is recorded as a failure. Specifically, return code 0 signifies successful verification with no specification violations, 1 indicates detected specification breaches, and other codes signify tool-related issues such as internal errors or timeouts. The entire toolchain operates within a preconfigured Anaconda ( Rolon-Mérette et al., 2016 ) virtual environment using Python 3.10 and Java 21.0.3 . We perform all verification tasks on a high-performance server equipped with an AMD EPYC 7643 48-core processor (supporting 96 threads with a base frequency of 2.0 GHz and boost up to 3.6 GHz ) and 503 GB of DDR4 memory ( 488 GB available). The system runs Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS with kernel version 6.8.0-47 .

paragraphs.en: Logical Strength assesses the logical quality of a specification by comparing it against a reference (ground-truth) specification: an ideal specification neither narrows the input domain nor loosens the output range relative to the reference ( Section 2.2 ). We normalize a specification into a set of guarded cases { ( g i , p i ) } \{(g_{i},p_{i})\} delimited by also , where g i g_{i} is the precondition (a requires clause, or the antecedent of a P ⇒ Q P\Rightarrow Q or P ⇔ Q P\Leftrightarrow Q postcondition) and p i p_{i} is the postcondition. An ensures with no requires (a partial specification ) is read as g i = true g_{i}=\texttt{true} , and a disjunctive precondition is kept whole, with unmentioned inputs treated as unconstrained. We align two specifications for the same method by normalized signature and align their cases by precondition overlap , merging several generated cases that match one reference case by disjoining their preconditions and conjoining their postconditions. Each aligned pair is then compared on two independent axes by SMT (Z3): a precondition axis , on which a precondition that admits a narrower input domain than the reference is logically weaker, and a postcondition axis , on which a postcondition that admits a wider output range, that is, that allows more outputs than the reference, is Logically Weaker . When the two axes disagree and neither specification dominates, the pair is Undecidable , reflecting a genuine strength trade-off: this arises when a wider precondition is paired with a looser postcondition, or a narrower precondition with a tighter postcondition. A wider precondition together with a tighter postcondition is logically Stronger .
paragraphs.zh: 逻辑强度通过将一个规范与参考（基准）规范进行比较来评估其逻辑质量：理想情况下，该规范相对于参考规范既不会缩小输入域，也不会放宽输出范围（第 2.2 节）。 我们将一个规范归约为由 also 分隔的一组受保护情况 { ( g i , p i ) } \{(g_{i},p_{i})\}，其中 g i g_{i} 是前提条件（一个 requires 子句，或 P ⇒ Q P\Rightarrow Q 或 P ⇔ Q P\Leftrightarrow Q 后件的前件），而 p i p_{i} 是后件。 没有 requires 的 ensures（一个部分规范）被解释为 g i = true g_{i}=\texttt{true}，而析取式前提条件则保持完整，未提及的输入被视为不受约束。 我们通过归约后的签名对齐同一方法的两个规范，并通过前提条件的重叠对其中的情况进行对齐，将匹配一个参考情况的多个生成情况合并，方法是将其前提条件进行析取，并将后条件进行合取。 随后，每个对齐的成对规范通过 SMT（Z3）在两个独立轴上进行比较：前提条件轴上，若某个前提条件所允许的输入域比参考规范更窄，则其逻辑强度更弱；后条件轴上，若某个后条件所允许的输出范围更广，即允许比参考规范更多的输出，则其逻辑强度更弱。 当两个轴的判断不一致且没有哪个规范占优时，该成对规范为“不可判定”，这反映了一种真正的强度权衡：这种情况发生在较宽的前提条件与较宽松的后条件结合，或较窄的前提条件与更严格的后条件结合时。 较宽的前提条件与更严格的后条件结合时，逻辑上更强。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we report the experimental results to answer each research question.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将报告实验结果，以回答每个研究问题。

paragraphs.en: To answer this research question, we assess the correctness of Path2Spec -generated specifications using the verifier. Specifically, for each of the base LLMs (GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-5, Qwen-Plus, and Deepseek-R1), we apply both Path2Spec and SpecGen using two benchmarks, i.e., SG-Bench and SV-COMP. The generated specifications for each program are then verified using OpenJML, where the number (#Passed) and proportion (%Passed) of passed programs are computed. Moreover, we perform an ablation study, where we test two variants of Path2Spec , Path-only and Decomposition-only, across the same four base LLMs on both benchmark datasets. The Path-only variant does not perform our decompose-then-retry strategy, while the Decomposition-only variant does not involve the execution path as guidance in the prompt.To separate the contribution of structured generation from that of verifier-guided iteration, we add a Path2Spec (Single-shot) baseline that applies the same path-then-decomposition structure with the repair loop disabled (–max-repairs 0).
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这一研究问题，我们使用验证器评估 Path2Spec 生成的规范的正确性。 具体来说，对于每个基础 LLM（GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-5、Qwen-Plus 和 Deepseek-R1），我们都使用两个基准数据集（即 SG-Bench 和 SV-COMP）分别应用 Path2Spec 和 SpecGen。 随后，使用 OpenJML 验证每个程序生成的规范，并计算通过程序的总数（#Passed）和比例（%Passed）。 此外，我们还进行了一项消融研究，在相同的四个基础 LLM 上，针对两个基准数据集测试了 Path2Spec 的两个变体：Path-only 和 Decomposition-only。 Path-only 变体不执行我们的“分解-重试”策略，而 Decomposition-only 变体则未将执行路径作为提示中的指导信息。为了区分结构化生成与验证器引导迭代各自的贡献，我们增加了一个 Path2Spec（Single-shot）基线模型，该模型应用了相同的“路径-分解”结构，但禁用了修复循环（–max-repairs 0）。

paragraphs.en: First, Path2Spec outperforms SpecGen consistently across all base LLMs and both benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our divide-and-conquer framework. For instance, when paired with GPT-5, Path2Spec achieves an overall %Passed of 84.4%, which is 33.2 percentage points higher than SpecGen’s 51.2%. Even for relatively weaker models like GPT-3.5-turbo, Path2Spec improves the overall pass rate from 41.6% to 61.8%, a 20.2-point gain. Path2Spec (Single-shot), , Structure alone already recovers a large share of the improvement over SpecGen: the overall pass rate rises from 51.2% to 66.2% for GPT-5 and from 41.6% to 49.9% for GPT-3.5-turbo before any verifier feedback is used . Iteration then contributes the remainder, adding a further 18.2 points for GPT-5 (66.2% → \rightarrow 84.4%) and 11.9 points for GPT-3.5-turbo (49.9% → \rightarrow 61.8%). For Qwen-Plus and DeepSeek-R1, structured generation is already sufficient to reach most of Path2Spec ’s accuracy in a single shot (e.g., DeepSeek-R1 reaches 74.0% overall without iteration), indicating that the value of iteration is largest exactly when the base model cannot yet produce a verifiable specification from structure alone.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，在所有基础 LLM 和两种基准测试中，Path2Spec 始终优于 SpecGen，这证明了我们的“分而治之”框架的有效性。 例如，当与 GPT-5 搭配使用时，Path2Spec 的整体通过率为 84.4%，比 SpecGen 的 51.2% 高出 33.2 个百分点。 即使对于像 GPT-3.5-turbo 这样相对较弱的模型，Path2Spec 也将整体通过率从 41.6% 提升至 61.8%，增加了 20.2 个百分点。 Path2Spec（单轮生成）中仅通过结构化生成，就已恢复了相对于 SpecGen 的大部分性能提升：对于 GPT-5，整体通过率从 51.2% 升至 66.2%；对于 GPT-3.5-turbo，则从 41.6% 升至 49.9%，且此时尚未使用任何验证器反馈。 随后，迭代过程贡献了剩余的提升：为 GPT-5 增加了 18.2 个百分点（66.2% → 84.4%），为 GPT-3.5-turbo 增加了 11.9 个百分点（49.9% → 61.8%）。 对于 Qwen-Plus 和 DeepSeek-R1，结构化生成已足以在单轮生成中达到 Path2Spec 的大部分准确率（例如，DeepSeek-R1 无需迭代即可达到 74.0% 的整体通过率），这表明迭代的价值恰恰在基础模型尚无法仅凭结构生成可验证规范时最大。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, the performance gap between Path2Spec and SpecGen is more pronounced in SV-COMP than in SG-Bench, which can be attributed to the distinct characteristics of the two benchmarks. SG-Bench consists of 120 small-scale programs with straightforward logic, where SpecGen can achieve moderate performance (50.0%–66.7% pass rates across models). In contrast, SV-COMP includes 265 complex, real-world programs with intricate control flows and challenging edge cases, where Path2Spec ’s ability to systematically leverage execution path information becomes particularly critical. For GPT-5, Path2Spec substantially boosts the SV-COMP pass rate from 44.2% (SpecGen) to 83.0%, a nearly twofold improvement. This indicates that Path2Spec is particularly effective in handling complex program semantics where path-aware reasoning is important.

paragraphs.en: To weigh the pass-rate gain against its cost, we measure the per-program computational budget of three configurations: SpecGen, single-shot Path2Spec (the same path-then-decomposition generation with the verifier-guided repair loop disabled), and the full Path2Spec pipeline. For each program we record the number of LLM calls, the total number of tokens, and the LLM generation time, and we report the average per program on each benchmark (Table 3 ).

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 3 , Path2Spec consumes more compute per program than SpecGen under every base model. The more important observation is that the structured generation itself is almost free: single-shot Path2Spec runs at a budget on par with SpecGen, far below the full pipeline. Its call count is a handful of calls per program, the same order as SpecGen’s, rather than the tens of calls the full pipeline uses. Its token budget is comparable as well. For GPT-3.5-turbo, single-shot uses about 5.0 5.0 k and 6.3 6.3 k tokens per program on SG-Bench and SV-COMP, against SpecGen’s 5.3 5.3 k and 8.4 8.4 k, so it is actually cheaper on the larger benchmark; for GPT-5 it uses 8.6 8.6 k and 6.7 6.7 k against 7.6 7.6 k and 7.8 7.8 k; and for Qwen-Plus 5.0 5.0 k and 6.6 6.6 k against 4.2 4.2 k and 6.7 6.7 k. Generation time falls in the same range. The only exception is DeepSeek-R1, whose single-shot token total is higher because the reasoning trace of the path and decomposition prompts is counted, yet even there the call budget stays small. This matters for interpreting the main results: single-shot Path2Spec already delivers most of the pass-rate and quality improvement over SpecGen at a cost that is essentially the same as SpecGen’s, which shows that the benefit of the structured, path-aware intermediate representation is obtained almost for free, and that the large budget of the full pipeline buys only the additional verifier-guided repair. Cost-sensitive users can therefore adopt single-shot Path2Spec directly and still obtain the bulk of the gains.

paragraphs.en: While automated verifiers like OpenJML can confirm syntactic correctness and basic semantic compliance, they cannot assess nuanced qualities such as specification completeness, boundary coverage comprehensiveness, and constraint expressiveness. To this end, we investigate their quality both qualitatively (through a human study) and quantitatively (through a logical strength check).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管像 OpenJML 这样的自动化验证工具能够确认语法正确性和基本的语义合规性，但它们无法评估诸如规格完整性、边界覆盖的全面性以及约束表达力等细微特性。 为此，我们从定性和定量两个角度对它们的质量进行了研究：定性方面通过一项人类研究，定量方面则通过逻辑强度检查。

paragraphs.en: For human study, we compare four approaches: SpecGen (baseline), Path2Spec (our complete framework), and its two ablated variants, Path2Spec (Decomposition-Only Strategy) and Path2Spec Path-only Strategy). All methods use GPT-5 as the base model to isolate the impact of our framework design from model capabilities. Following statistical sampling principles with 95% confidence level and ±5% margin of error, we select 92 programs from SG-Bench and 158 programs from SV-COMP, totaling 250 samples. Two programmers, each with at least 3 years of Java programming experience, independently evaluate the generated specifications. To ensure fairness and prevent evaluators from developing bias toward specific methods, we randomly label each approach corresponding to the generated specification as A, B, C, or D. We then employ a comparative ranking strategy ( Liu et al., 2022 ) rather than absolute scoring, as directly assigning quality scores (e.g., 1-5) is prone to high rater variance. Instead, evaluators rank the four specifications for each program from A (best) to D (worst) based on four criteria: completeness, boundary value coverage, constraint expressiveness, and coverage of all program behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: 在人类研究中，我们比较了四种方法：SpecGen（基线）、Path2Spec（我们的完整框架），以及它的两种删减变体：Path2Spec（仅分解策略）和 Path2Spec（仅路径策略）。 所有方法均使用 GPT-5 作为基础模型，以将我们框架设计的影响与模型能力区分开来。 遵循统计抽样原则，在 95% 的置信水平和 ±5% 的误差范围内，我们从 SG-Bench 中选取了 92 个程序，从 SV-COMP 中选取了 158 个程序，总计 250 个样本。 两名程序员（每人至少拥有 3 年 Java 编程经验）独立评估生成的规格说明。 为确保公平性并防止评估者对特定方法产生偏见，我们将每个方法与其对应的生成规格说明随机标记为 A、B、C 或 D。 我们随后采用比较排序策略（Liu et al., 2022），而非绝对评分，因为直接分配质量分数（例如 1-5）容易引发评估者间的高度差异。 相反，评估者根据四个标准对每个程序的四种规格说明进行排序：从 A（最佳）到 D（最差），这四个标准分别是完整性、边界值覆盖、约束表达能力以及对所有程序行为的覆盖程度。

sents.en: For human study, we compare four approaches: SpecGen (baseline), Path2Spec (our complete framework), and its two ablated variants, Path2Spec (Decomposition-Only Strategy) and Path2Spec Path-only Strategy).

sents.en: Following statistical sampling principles with 95% confidence level and ±5% margin of error, we select 92 programs from SG-Bench and 158 programs from SV-COMP, totaling 250 samples.

sents.en: We then employ a comparative ranking strategy ( Liu et al., 2022 ) rather than absolute scoring, as directly assigning quality scores (e.g., 1-5) is prone to high rater variance.

paragraphs.en: We developed a logical comparison tool that operates as follows: First, it extracts the precondition and postcondition clauses from the ground truth program. Then, it identifies different case-specific (precondition, postcondition) pairs based on JML ( Leavens et al., 2008 ) syntax symbols such as also , ==> , <==> , and <== that distinguish between different cases. Next, it decomposes the preconditions and postconditions into logical formulas. Finally, it invokes the Z3 ( De Moura and Bjørner, 2008 ) solver to prove the containment relationship between the LLM-generated precondition and the ground truth precondition, as well as between the LLM-generated postcondition and the ground truth postcondition. We compare the two specifications on two independent axes, the precondition domain and the postcondition. If the generated precondition is weaker or equivalent and the generated postcondition is stronger or equivalent, the pair is recorded as complete. If the generated precondition is more restrictive and the postcondition is looser, so that it is dominated on both axes, the pair is recorded as incomplete. If the two axes disagree, that is, a wider precondition with a looser postcondition or a narrower precondition with a tighter postcondition, or if the solver cannot decide a construct, the pair is recorded as undecidable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种逻辑比较工具，其运行方式如下：首先，它从基准程序中提取前提条件和后置条件子句。 然后，它基于 JML（Leavens 等人，2008）的语法符号（例如 also、==>、<==> 和 <==），识别出不同的特定情况（前提条件、后置条件）对，这些符号用于区分不同情况。 接下来，它将前提条件和后置条件分解为逻辑公式。 最后，它调用 Z3（De Moura 和 Bjørner，2008）求解器，以证明 LLM 生成的前提条件与基准前提条件之间的包含关系，以及 LLM 生成的后置条件与基准后置条件之间的包含关系。 我们在两个独立维度上比较这两种规范：前提条件域和后置条件。 如果生成的前提条件更弱或等价，且生成的后置条件更强或等价，则该对被记录为完整。 如果生成的前提条件更严格，而后置条件更宽松，从而在两个维度上均被主导，则该对被记录为不完整。 如果两个维度的结果不一致，即前提条件更宽泛但后置条件更宽松，或前提条件更狭窄但后置条件更严格，或者求解器无法对某个结构做出判断，则该对被记录为不可判定。

paragraphs.en: To analyze whether SpecGen generates complete formal specifications and to further validate the quality of Path2Spec-generated formal specifications, we run both SpecGen and Path2Spec , using all four base models (GPT-3.5-turbo, Qwen-Plus, DeepSeek-R1, and GPT-5), on the SpecEval dataset, which contains ground truth specifications. We then use our logical comparison tool to compare the formal specifications generated by SpecGen and Path2Spec against the ground truth to understand their quality gap.

paragraphs.en: We first build a manually validated gold reference. A senior annotator with more than three years of symbolic-execution experience enumerates each program’s feasible execution paths as (precondition, postcondition) pairs, where the precondition characterizes the path’s input condition and the postcondition characterizes its symbolic output. We then derive paths from both Java PathFinder (SPF) and the LLMs, and compare each producer’s paths against this manual reference. SPF produces usable paths for only 81 / 385 81/385 programs, since the rest fail on string-heavy operations, environment-dependent behavior, missing executable harnesses, or timeout and path explosion, so we conduct the study on exactly these 81 81 programs to enable a fair head-to-head. They contain 267 267 reference paths with formal value-returning. Each producer’s paths are matched against the gold reference with the SMT solver Z3. A reference path is Correct when a produced path matches both its precondition and its postcondition; Missed when the reference path is not covered by any produced path; Inc-Pre when the postcondition is correct but under a wrong precondition; Inc-Pos when the precondition matches but the postcondition is wrong; and Not-compared when the postcondition uses a construct Z3 cannot decide, such as recursion, arrays, or strings. These five categories partition the reference formal paths and sum to one hundred percent for each producer. Infeasible is a produced path that no input can ever take, because its precondition is unsatisfiable. We report this count as a rate over the number of extracted paths and list it separately from the six categories above.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先构建一个经过人工验证的黄金参考集。 一位拥有超过三年符号执行经验的高级标注员，将每个程序的所有可行执行路径枚举为（前提条件，后置条件）对，其中前提条件描述了该路径的输入条件，后置条件则描述了其符号输出。 接着，我们从 Java PathFinder (SPF) 和 LLM 中分别生成路径，并将每个生成器的路径与这一人工参考集进行比较。 SPF 仅为 81 / 385 个程序生成了可用的路径（81/385），因为其余程序因字符串密集型操作、依赖环境的行为、缺少可执行测试框架、超时或路径爆炸等问题而失败，因此我们将研究严格限定在这 81 个程序上，以确保公平的直接对比。 这些路径包含 267 条具有形式化返回值定义的参考路径（267）。 我们使用 SMT 求解器 Z3，将每个生成器的路径与黄金参考集进行匹配。 当生成的路径同时匹配参考路径的前提条件和后置条件时，该参考路径被视为“正确”；若没有任何生成的路径覆盖参考路径，则视为“遗漏”；若后置条件正确但前提条件错误，则视为“前提条件不一致”；若前提条件正确但后置条件错误，则视为“后置条件不一致”；若后置条件使用了 Z3 无法判断的结构（如递归、数组或字符串），则视为“未比较”。 这五种类别对参考形式化路径进行了完全划分，且对于每个生成器而言，其总和为百分之百。 “不可行”指生成的路径是任何输入都无法执行的，因为其前提条件是不可满足的。 我们将这一计数作为提取路径总数中的一个比率进行报告，并单独列出，不与上述六种类别合并。

paragraphs.en: As reported in Table 7 , three findings emerge that the downstream pass rate cannot reveal. First, LLM-based path discovery is high and largely model-agnostic: capable models reach 85 85 – 91 % 91\% Correct, with very low Missed rates of 0.4 0.4 – 1.1 % 1.1\% and Infeasible rates of 0 0 – 1.1 % 1.1\% , so the LLM rarely omits a feasible path or invents an infeasible one. Second, the dominant LLM failure mode is an incorrect postcondition (Inc-Pos) rather than a missing path. This is most visible for GPT-3.5, whose Inc-Pos rate is 15.4 % 15.4\% , driven by sign and logic errors, and it is precisely the intrinsic weakness that the pass-rate view hid. Third, Java PathFinder misses far more paths than LLM extraction, 13.5 % 13.5\% against 0.4 0.4 – 1.1 % 1.1\% , because it is limited by path-explosion cutoffs and encoding restrictions, so its advantage is soundness rather than completeness. Taken together, these results confirm that LLM extraction is substantially more complete than symbolic execution, and that the symbolic-execution reference is itself imperfect, which is what motivates validating against a manually curated gold standard.

paragraphs.en: Scalability with structural complexity. Table 9 reports how the pass rate changes as the number of paths, branches, loops, and the control-flow nesting depth grow, pooled over the four base models and both benchmarks. On simple programs SpecGen and single-shot Path2Spec perform similarly, but as structural complexity grows the gap opens in Path2Spec’s favour: with ten or more execution paths its pass rate is 62 % 62\% against SpecGen’s 24 % 24\% , and it also leads on programs with three to five branches ( 68 % 68\% vs. 45 % 45\% ), two or more loops ( 40 % 40\% vs. 26 % 26\% ), and nesting depth three ( 40 % 40\% vs. 20 % 20\% ). This confirms that the benefit of structured, path-aware generation is concentrated exactly in the path-explosion regime where a single unstructured prompt struggles.

paragraphs.en: Loop-heavy programs. Loop reasoning is the hardest case for specification generation, so we analyze it directly. Of the 385 programs, 100 contain a loop (SG-Bench: 42 one-loop, 29 multi-loop; SV-COMP: 15 one-loop, 14 multi-loop). Table 10 reports verification pass counts on loop programs, comparing SpecGen and Path2Spec per model. Pass counts generally drop from one loop to multiple loops for both methods. On SG-Bench the two are close: Path2Spec leads in most cells (e.g., Qwen-Plus 31 / 20 31/20 vs. 21 / 14 21/14 ), while SpecGen is slightly higher on a few (single-loop GPT-3.5-turbo 23 23 vs. 21 21 , and multi-loop DeepSeek-R1 19 19 vs. 17 17 and GPT-5 17 17 vs. 16 16 ). paragraphs.en: The most evident difference appears in Error . paragraphs.en: Limitations of the Verification Criterion. Our evaluation relies exclusively on OpenJML, and a specification is counted as correct only if OpenJML returns exit code 0 . Because OpenJML is prone to timeouts on complex verification tasks, some specifications may fail to verify within the time limit (30 minutes) even though they are correct, and are therefore recorded as failures. This criterion is conservative: it may underestimate the number of valid specifications, but it applies equally to Path2Spec and the baseline and thus does not favor either approach. paragraphs.en: Verification-Driven Termination. Both path-based specification generation and decompose-then-retry use the verifier’s pass/fail result to decide whether to continue. This strategy ignores specification quality: even when specifications for the current subprograms are successfully verified, further decomposition into smaller subprograms might yield more complete specifications. This reflects an inherent trade-off between quality and efficiency, since generating more subprograms increases computational cost and the number of LLM queries. Our results nevertheless show that subprogram-level generation already improves both correctness and logical strength. In future work, we plan to extend Path2Spec with an adaptive, quality-aware decomposition strategy to better balance this trade-off.

paragraphs.en: Traditional tools for generating formal specifications have evolved through various technical approaches, which can be broadly categorized as follows: Dynamic analysis tools, primarily represented by Daikon ( Ernst et al., 2007 ) , Agitator ( Boshernitsan et al., 2006 ) , and DIDUCE ( Hangal and Lam, 2002 ) , derive invariants by observing runtime behavior ( Lo et al., 2008a ; Lo et al., 2007 ; Lo et al., 2008b ) . However, these methods rely heavily on the quantity and quality of test cases, and the inferred "invariants" may only apply to observed execution paths, thus failing to accurately cover all possible execution scenarios during sequencing. Within the dynamic analysis paradigm, specification mining approaches have sought to address these limitations through specialized techniques. Lo and Khoo’s QUARK framework ( Lo and Khoo, 2006a ) provided a systematic methodology for empirically evaluating automaton-based specification miners, establishing quality metrics for temporal specifications extracted from program traces. Building on this, their SMArTIC approach ( Lo and Khoo, 2006b ) employed a "divide and conquer" strategy for specification generation that shares conceptual similarities with our methodology. Static analysis tools, such as Houdini ( Flanagan and Leino, 2001 ) , ESC/Java ( Cok and Kiniry, 2004 ) , and CodeSonar ( Jetley et al., 2008 ) , derive program specifications primarily through theorem proofs and logical reasoning, thus limiting their reasoning capabilities when handling complex program logic. Symbolic execution tools, primarily represented by JavaPathFinder (JPF) ( Mehlitz et al., 2013 ) , and S2E ( Chipounov et al., 2011 ) , systematically explore program paths, treating program inputs as symbolic variables to cover more potential execution scenarios ( Xie et al., 2017 ) . They can handle path conditions and generate high-coverage test cases or specifications. However, these methods still suffer from the "path explosion" problem when facing complex control flow, loops, and recursive structures, and their scalability is challenged.

paragraphs.en: LLMs’ in-context learning ( Dong et al., 2024 ) capability enables them to learn from examples provided in prompts without requiring model retraining, which allows them to adapt to new tasks easily ( Bouzenia et al., 2024 ; Ryan et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Huang and Zhu, 2023 ) . Empirical results demonstrate that LLMs have achieved good performance on generation tasks across multiple fields ( Ugare et al., 2024 ) , prompting recent exploration of their application to formal specification generation. Current LLM-based approaches for formal specification generation can be broadly categorized into two types. The first category involves collecting domain-specific data and training specialized models for specification generation. For example, recent work ( Pei et al., 2023 ) investigates whether LLMs can reason about program invariants through fine-tuning on curated datasets. The second category leverages existing pre-trained LLMs through carefully designed generation workflows and precise prompting strategies to guide specification generation. For instance, AutoSpec ( Wen et al., 2024 ) introduced the first framework for bottom-up generation of C program specifications, while SpecGen ( Ma et al., 2025 ) developed an iterative repair mechanism for Java programs. SpecRover ( Ruan et al., 2024 ) focused on extracting high-level design specifications from code intent. Since the formal specifications generated by SpecRover belong to a different category from ours, we did not compare our results with those of SpecRover.

paragraphs.en: While these approaches established the feasibility of LLMs for specification tasks, they still face notable limitations in the quality of the generated specifications, especially in their coverage of the program’s behaviors. They often generate overly broad or incomplete specifications that fail to capture the various execution behaviors contained in the program. In contrast, Path2Spec addresses the challenges of generating both correct and high-quality program specifications by systematically guiding an LLM to reason over individual execution paths. When generation fails, Path2Spec employs a decompose-then-retry strategy that decomposes the program with multiple execution paths into subprograms with single or fewer execution paths, ensuring the LLM consistently generates specifications guided by execution path information, thereby producing path-specific and highly detailed specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些方法证明了大型语言模型（LLM）在规范生成任务中的可行性，但它们在生成的规范质量方面仍存在显著局限性，尤其是在对程序行为的覆盖范围上。 它们常常生成过于宽泛或不完整的规范，无法捕捉程序中包含的各种执行行为。 相比之下，Path2Spec 通过系统性地引导大型语言模型对单个执行路径进行推理，解决了生成既正确又高质量程序规范所面临的挑战。 当生成失败时，Path2Spec 会采用“分解-重试”策略：将具有多条执行路径的程序分解为仅有一条或更少执行路径的子程序，从而确保大型语言模型始终在执行路径信息的引导下生成规范，最终产出针对特定路径且高度详细的规范。

paragraphs.en: Based on the analysis in this paper, we identify two critical quality issues in state-of-the-art automated formal specification generation methods. First, even when specifications pass verification tests, they often have incomplete coverage, failing to capture all program execution behavior. For instance, if a program can execute along multiple different paths, the generated specification may only correctly describe a few of those paths. Second, models tend to generate postconditions that are too generic, these overly broad specifications don’t meaningfully capture how the program actually behaves across its different execution paths.
paragraphs.zh: 基于本文的分析，我们识别出当前最先进的自动化形式化规格生成方法中存在两个关键的质量问题。 首先，即使生成的规格通过了验证测试，它们通常也存在覆盖不完整的问题，无法捕捉程序的所有执行行为。 例如，如果一个程序可以沿着多条不同的路径执行，那么生成的规格可能只能正确描述其中少数几条路径。 其次，模型倾向于生成过于通用的后置条件，这些过度宽泛的规格无法有效反映程序在不同执行路径上的实际行为。

sents.en: Second, models tend to generate postconditions that are too generic, these overly broad specifications don’t meaningfully capture how the program actually behaves across its different execution paths.
sents.zh: 其次，模型倾向于生成过于通用的后置条件，这些过度宽泛的规格无法有效反映程序在不同执行路径上的实际行为。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we propose Path2Spec , a divide-and-conquer framework that systematically guides LLMs to reason over individual execution paths, generating path-specific specifications that are subsequently merged into comprehensive program specifications. For complex programs, Path2Spec employs a decompose-then-retry strategy that recursively breaks down programs into smaller subprograms based on logical branches. Our experiments on SG-Bench and SV-COMP demonstrate that Path2Spec achieves substantial improvements over existing methods, increasing overall performance from 51.2% to 84.4%. Human evaluation further confirms that Path2Spec produces the highest-quality specifications (score: 3.4 out of 4 ), exhibiting more rigorous constraints and more thorough coverage of program behavior. This work demonstrates that path-guided generation significantly enhances the accuracy and quality of LLM-generated formal specifications, paving the way for more robust and scalable automated program verification.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 Path2Spec——一种分而治之的框架，它能系统性地引导大型语言模型（LLM）对单个执行路径进行推理，生成特定于该路径的规范，随后将这些规范合并为全面的程序规范。 对于复杂程序，Path2Spec 采用“分解-重试”策略，根据逻辑分支递归地将程序拆分为更小的子程序。 我们在 SG-Bench 和 SV-COMP 上进行的实验表明，Path2Spec 相较于现有方法实现了显著提升，将整体性能从 51.2% 提高到了 84.4%。 人类评估进一步证实，Path2Spec 生成的规范质量最高（评分：4 分制下的 3.4 分），展现出更严格的约束以及对程序行为的更全面覆盖。 这项工作表明，路径引导的生成方法能显著提升大型语言模型所生成形式化规范的准确性和质量，为更稳健、可扩展的自动化程序验证开辟了道路。

paragraphs.en: Based on the results and analysis of this experiment, we find that the verification method for specifications itself significantly impacts the quality of specification generation. Therefore, building upon this work, our future research will focus on two main directions. The first direction involves further investigating specification verification methods, including assessing the completeness of generated specifications, determining whether generated specifications can fully describe code behavior, and evaluating whether generated specifications can accurately capture the correct value ranges of key variables. The second direction focuses on further improving the quality of automatically generated formal specifications, including training a specialized large model dedicated to specification generation and constructing a precise dataset to provide better guidance for model training.
paragraphs.zh: 根据本次实验的结果与分析，我们发现规格说明的验证方法本身对规格说明生成的质量有显著影响。 因此，基于这项研究，我们未来的工作将聚焦于两个主要方向。 第一个方向是进一步研究规格说明的验证方法，包括评估所生成规格说明的完整性，判断其能否完整描述代码行为，以及评估其能否准确捕捉关键变量的正确取值范围。 第二个方向则致力于进一步提升自动生成的形式化规格说明的质量，包括训练一个专门用于规格说明生成的专用大模型，并构建一个精确的数据集以更好地指导模型训练。

sents.en: Based on the results and analysis of this experiment, we find that the verification method for specifications itself significantly impacts the quality of specification generation.
sents.zh: 根据本次实验的结果与分析，我们发现规格说明的验证方法本身对规格说明生成的质量有显著影响。

sents.en: Therefore, building upon this work, our future research will focus on two main directions.
sents.zh: 因此，基于这项研究，我们未来的工作将聚焦于两个主要方向。

sents.en: The first direction involves further investigating specification verification methods, including assessing the completeness of generated specifications, determining whether generated specifications can fully describe code behavior, and evaluating whether generated specifications can accurately capture the correct value ranges of key variables.
sents.zh: 第一个方向是进一步研究规格说明的验证方法，包括评估所生成规格说明的完整性，判断其能否完整描述代码行为，以及评估其能否准确捕捉关键变量的正确取值范围。

sents.en: The second direction focuses on further improving the quality of automatically generated formal specifications, including training a specialized large model dedicated to specification generation and constructing a precise dataset to provide better guidance for model training.
sents.zh: 第二个方向则致力于进一步提升自动生成的形式化规格说明的质量，包括训练一个专门用于规格说明生成的专用大模型，并构建一个精确的数据集以更好地指导模型训练。

paragraphs.zh: 为便于未来研究，我们在 https://github.com/papersrepo2025/Path2Spec.git 上发布了本文的数据和源代码。
